title: Idea Recovery
text: Built a system that scans my entire digital life — Apple Notes exports, Obsidian vault, project directories, Hermes sessions, 50+ Git repos — looking for ideas I forgot I had.

title: Fleet Audit
text: Cleaned 14 dead services. Three launchd services running stale duplicates. Eleven plist files dead stubs from old experiments. Port 8001 had an MLX server that accepted TCP but never responded.

title: Kinetic Hero
text: 7 orbital debris objects with independent mechanics. 800 turbulent ember particles via custom GLSL shaders. 4-pass post-processing stack. Zero dependencies beyond Three.js. No React. No build step.

title: Brand System
text: Seventeen design iterations. Not Figma right — photocopied-at-Kinkos, sharpie-on-a-CD-cover right. Creed blocks got 3D tilt. Statement section got depth shadows. The design IS the identity.
